records.localization_note: Hodram Bergstrom remains the short header. Maria uses the running surname; Sera and Sirwood use the given name.
Maria Li is the nameplate for the woman summoning Hodram and later warning him. The messenger uses Admiral Maria Li when identifying her.
Xien Yan remains the approved nameplate for the intermediary who ushers Hodram to Admiral Li.
Gerhard Adernkatz can bring and read the same letter as Charles. He speaks in his own formal register outside the quotation.
Charles Rochefort is the alternative reader. His spoken introduction and closing need not match Gerhard's.
Sera Shahrbaraz keeps the same short header when she returns to help and when she speaks with her compatriots.
Barbarossa Hayreddin is the current header. The port worker and Hodram use Hayreddin in their own dialogue.
Diogo Escante is the established name. The notices and Hodram refer to him by his surname.
Sirwood Eme remains the nameplate. He calls Hodram by the runtime given name and continues in the original symbols.
Port Worker identifies the source role of the man reporting the navy's defeat of Hayreddin.
Sailor identifies the original messenger role without adding a rank to the emissary.
